parameters.name: course_count
parameters.description: Number of courses in the finite course set $\mathcal{C}$

parameters.name: category_count
parameters.description: Number of academic categories in the finite category set $\mathcal{K}$

parameters.name: eligibility_matrix
parameters.description: Binary eligibility indicator for course-category pairs; 1 if course $c$ can satisfy category $k$

parameters.name: category_requirement
parameters.description: Minimum required number of credited courses for each category $k$

parameters.name: prerequisite_matrix
parameters.description: Binary prerequisite indicator for course pairs; 1 if selecting course $i$ requires selecting course $j$

variables.name: selected_course
variables.description: Binary decision variable equal to 1 if course $c$ is selected

variables.name: category_credit
variables.description: Binary decision variable equal to 1 if selected course $c$ is credited toward category $k$

constraints.name: selected_course_binary_domain
constraints.description: The course selection variable is binary for each course

constraints.name: category_credit_binary_domain
constraints.description: The category credit variable is binary for each course-category pair

constraints.name: total_selected_courses_integer_domain
constraints.description: The total selected courses variable is a nonnegative integer

constraints.name: credit_only_if_selected
constraints.description: A course may be credited to a category only if the course is selected

constraints.name: category_minimum_credit
constraints.description: Each category must receive at least its required minimum number of credited courses

constraints.name: prerequisite_selection
constraints.description: Selecting a course requires selecting all of its prerequisite courses
constraints.formula: x_i \le x_j \quad \forall i,j\in\{0,\dots,N-1\} \text{ such that } r_{ij}=1

constraints.name: single_selection_period
constraints.description: The model applies to one course-selection period only

constraints.name: eligibility_cap
constraints.description: A course-category pair can receive credit only if the course is eligible for that category; ineligible pairs are forced to zero credit

constraints.name: total_selected_courses_definition
constraints.description: Define the total number of selected courses as the sum of course selection variables

objectives.name: selection_cost_minimization
objectives.description: Minimize the total selection cost of the chosen courses; under unit costs, this is equivalent to minimizing the number of selected courses

final_objective.description: Minimize the total selection cost of the chosen courses.
